integrity: Entire symbolic checker and analytic polynomial positivity certificate provided; all sampling checks are supplementary, not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact for all positive three-path lengths in the canonical cycle-space Euclidean metric; no generalization to arbitrary genus-two graphs or higher moments. The second moment and Voronoi representation are prior work. Bibliographic novelty requires independent confirmation.
title: Sharp radial fourth-moment bounds for theta-graph tropical Voronoi hexagons
